text: You took the doubling penny over a million bucks. Day twenty: about five grand.
Regret it yet? The deal: one penny, doubles daily, thirty days, no taxes.
Tap the heart if you'd be sweating, 'cause day ten was five bucks. Five.
Day twenty-seven? Six hundred seventy-one grand. Still— still losing to the million.
Send this to the friend who'd quit right here.
Day twenty-eight, you finally pass it.
Day thirty: five point three seven million.
So: penny or million? One word.
